blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (Opapru) on Saturday urged members of the newly constituted Bangsamoro Parliament to bridge diverse perspectives and work together as the region begins its first regular parliamentary government. In a statement, Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento, Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity, congratulated the Parliament’s newly elected leaders, headed by Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua and Parliament Speaker Amer Zaakaria Rakim. He also congratulated the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) government and Parliament on the successful conduct of its inaugural session on Oct. 30. “As this […]...
